siteModes.proposedDescription: Proposed Tirumala 4 G+1 residence on the 40 x 50 ft plot with all pre-construction interior plot trees cleared from the building, forecourt, lower car porch, veranda, and pathways. Perimeter planting and colony streetscape retained.
siteModes.existingDescription: Pre-construction existing plot state (R07, R10, R12, V05, V06) sharing the exact 40 x 50 ft boundary, horizontally grooved NE corner pier (R11), muted mauve-taupe boundary wall, dry red-brown soil, concrete footing blocks (R07), and existing mature trees prior to house construction.

colonyRealismUpgrades.roads: Owner-supplied 12.0 m North and 9.0 m East overall road corridors. Verge/carriageway split, joints and drain spacing are visual estimates; the verges are included within those widths.
colonyRealismUpgrades.verges: Interlocking concrete brick/zig-zag paver verges in weathered dusty-rose and warm grey (R11, R14, V03, V05).
colonyRealismUpgrades.boundaryWalls: Low plastered masonry walls in muted mauve-taupe (#8e7e85) with pale grey coping (#c8c4bc) and horizontally grooved square corner pier at the NE junction (R11, R14, V02, V05).
colonyRealismUpgrades.hedges: Mixed roadside shrub planting combining reddish-burgundy copperleaf (Acalypha wilkesiana) and green crape jasmine (Tabernaemontana divaricata) with small white blossoms (R10, R12, V03, V05).
colonyRealismUpgrades.streetlights: Slim dark-grey tubular steel poles on concrete plinths with angled LED luminaire heads (R09, R13, R14, V04) plus round-hooded post-top park lamp at the east basketball court (V01).
colonyRealismUpgrades.neighbours: Owner correction, 31 October 2026: adjoining lots are vacant and shown with grass. Earlier South/West house placeholders are removed. The white/navy house across the North garden and distant road-opposite colony landmarks remain.
